summary: Display "Dispensed" Status in Prescription Details Section (Consistent with "Cancelled" and "Paused")
description:
The "Dispensed" status currently appears only in the History and Comments section of the Medication Dispensing module, whereas other statuses such as "Cancelled" and "Paused" are displayed in the Prescription Details section.
Expected:
Once a medication is dispensed, the "Dispensed" status should be displayed in the Prescription Details section—just like "Cancelled" and "Paused" statuses following cancel or pause actions. This will ensure a consistent and streamlined user experience and reduce the risk of errors.
